field.label: MCC
field.help: Define the Mobile Country Code (MCC) for the network.

field.label: MNC
field.help: Define the Mobile Network Code (MNC) for the network.

field.label: TAC
field.help: Define the Tracking Area Code (TAC) for the network.

field.label: Network Name
field.help: Define the Service Provider Name (SPN) for the network.

field.label: Slice/Service Type
field.help: Set the SST (1–255) of the first AMF slice and NSSF mapping for 5G SA.

field.label: S1 Bind Address
field.help: Set the MME S1AP address for 4G and 5G NSA, or the AMF NGAP address for 5G SA.

field.label: SGW-U GTP-U Bind Address
field.help: For 4G and 5G NSA, enter the SGW-U address reachable by the radio network. Leave blank to reuse the S1AP address.

field.label: UPF GTP-U Bind Address
field.help: For 5G SA or UPF mode, enter the address UPF uses for GTP-U. Leave blank to keep the existing UPF address.

field.label: ue
field.help: Define the max number of UEs (User Equipment) supported by the network.

field.label: Peer
field.help: Define the max number of eNB or gNB hosted radios.
